findings: `formatDateTime` crash on "Never" — `new Date("Never")` is `Invalid Date`; renders as "Invalid Date Invalid Date" in the Staff table for any member whose `lastActive` is "Never". Guard with `if (!iso || iso === 'Never') return 'Never';` before constructing the Date.

`export const instant = false` is not a Next.js directive — silently ignored by Next.js. The stated protective intent (opt out of static prerender) is not achieved. Replace with `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';`.

Hardcoded `#3d6b4f` in analytics charts — `RevenueBarChart` and `OccupancyLineChart` use `fill` / `stroke` attributes that don't resolve CSS variables. Replace with `style={{ fill: 'var(--db-accent)' }}` / `style={{ stroke: 'var(--db-accent)' }}`.

`SubscriptionPage` ignores `MOCK_HOTEL.subscription` — plan name, price, and feature list are hardcoded. `void MOCK_HOTEL` suppresses the lint warning. Derive the current plan from `MOCK_HOTEL.subscription`.

Inventory `formatDateHeader` uses local time — `new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00')` parses in local time; can display the wrong weekday for UTC-offset users. Change to `new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00Z')` to match the rest of the codebase.

Check-in button active on cancelled/no-show bookings — when a search query is active, `check-in/page.tsx` shows all statuses and the "Confirm Check-in" button is enabled for `cancelled` and `no_show` records. Filter out terminal statuses from search results or disable the button for non-actionable statuses.
